turns.speaker: agent

turns.text: I was hoping you could let me know if you have size 8 in stock. The website says its unavailable.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We refill at the end of the month I suggest checking then

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can do for you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is all I needed to know. Thank you

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: All right. Well Thanks for reaching out and have a great day!
